question: What fluorine mass ratio was measured on the surface of the cathode rejects, and what after the Cyrene separation?
rendered: According to page 5, the mass ratio of fluorine element on the surface of the cathode rejects was 12.49%, and after the Cyrene-based separation process, it was greatly reduced to 0.14%.
